monthly_review.summary: You significantly increased volume and intensity this month, with faster paces, higher HR, more time in Zones 3–4, and improved running economy — a clear step toward greater aerobic power.
monthly_review.highlight: Zone distribution shifted dramatically: Zone 3 rose from 19% to 31% and Zone 4 from 3% to 15%, indicating a purposeful and effective shift toward threshold and moderate-intensity work.

goal_tracker.message: You’ve already exceeded last month’s total distance by 15.0 km and run count by 1 — no additional running is needed this month to surpass May’s totals.

insights.title: Efficiency gains align with cadence and stride improvements
insights.body: Aerobic efficiency increased from 13.42 to 13.46 while avg cadence rose +5 spm and stride length increased notably — e.g., 72.2 cm on 6/28 vs 63.31 cm on 6/19 — suggesting better neuromuscular coordination and force application.

insights.title: Strategic intensification: Zone 3 & 4 time doubled collectively
insights.body: Time spent in Zones 3+4 increased from 22% (19% Z3 + 3% Z4) in May to 46% (31% Z3 + 15% Z4) in June — a strong signal of intentional threshold development, supported by rising avg HR (+4 bpm) and faster best pace (392 → 447 sec/km).

insights.title: Reduced ground contact time correlates with faster efforts
insights.body: Ground contact time decreased from 344 ms (6/19 recovery run) to 312 ms (6/28 at 8:53 min/km), coinciding with improved cadence (146 → 154 spm) and lower vertical oscillation variability — signs of more economical, race-relevant form.

insights.title: Limited Z1 volume may impact fatigue management
insights.body: Z1 time dropped from 36% in May to just 24% in June — below the recommended 25–35% for sustainable aerobic base maintenance in recreational runners; recent short runs (e.g., 6/19 at 112 bpm) show effective low-HR recovery, but frequency declined.

recommendations.action: Do one 45-min Zone 1 run (HR ≤125 bpm) before month-end — aim for avg HR 118–123 bpm and cadence ≥145 spm.
recommendations.reason: Z1 volume fell to 24% (vs 36% last month); this will restore aerobic recovery capacity without adding fatigue, especially given your elevated Z3/Z4 load this month.

recommendations.action: Perform a 6-km progressive run: start at 9:30 min/km (Z2), increase to 8:45 min/km (upper Z3) by km 4, finish at 8:30 min/km (lower Z4) — target avg HR 146–150 bpm.
recommendations.reason: Your 6/28 run at 8:53 min/km and 149 bpm shows readiness for sustained Z4 effort; this session bridges Z3 endurance and Z4 stamina with controlled progression.

recommendations.action: Add 2 × 30-sec cadence drills post-run: focus on quick turnover (170+ spm) barefoot or in minimalist shoes on grass, emphasizing light footstrike and reduced vertical oscillation (<7.5 cm).
recommendations.reason: Vertical oscillation has trended upward (7.2 → 7.9 cm) during faster runs; these drills reinforce neuromuscular efficiency gains seen in your rising cadence and falling ground contact time.

weekly_focus.description: Build durability at lactate threshold pace while protecting recovery — prioritize quality over quantity, embed neuromuscular efficiency work, and rebalance Z1 volume.
suggested_sessions: 45-min Zone 2 endurance run with 4 × 1-min Z3 strides
